'''R5-U8''' was an [[R5-series astromech droid]] that served in [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] as the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] for [[Flyby]]. Their [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter]] was disabled during the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]].
